note: Dummy Form on the SelectorsHub practice page. Run: node scripts/scenario.mjs scenarios/dummy-form.json

steps.note: the email id is randomized per load (shub39, shub76, ...) and the field is readonly until focused — fill() alone times out
bare <button> with no type and no <form> — submits nothing, so the assertion below is that the values survived

steps.expression: (async () => { const want = { email: `.userform input[type='email']`, password: `#pass`, company: `.userform input[name='company']`, mobile: `.userform input[name='mobile number']`, country: `.userform label > input[type='text']` }; const got = {}; for (const k of Object.keys(want)) { const el = document.querySelector(want[k]); got[k] = el ? el.value : null; if (!got[k]) throw new Error(k + ` is empty — the value did not stick`); } return got; })()
